title: Andy Hagerman (The Design Gym): 'I found his new work utterly amazing'
summary: Hagerman co-founded The Design Gym. He wrote up the 2026 Masters of Scale Summit in San Francisco and put Eric's session among his highlights of the three days.
blockquote: I found his new work utterly amazing, bringing just beautiful, thoughtful language to reframing how we think about purpose, mission, values, and growth.
